column1: # UTF-8 CSV. Lines starting with # are comments. Blank lines are ignored.
# ECGI is PLMN digits plus the ECI as 9 decimal digits (23415 + ECI 0 = 23415000000000).
# Matching prefers 4G ECGI when the list and the serving cell both have it
# (same sector on another EARFCN still hits). Otherwise ECI
# A listed ECGI that disagrees with the serving ECGI does not fall back to PCI.
# PLMN is only a tie-break when ECGI is absent. A roaming SIM in limited service still matches.
